text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Should I pick the card on the right? Or
the one in
the middle?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Aha! The one on the left must be the
joker! Hehe.
Your poker face is awful,
Chiyo!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Waaah! I was trying so hard, too! Urgh...
I
definitely won't lose next time!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Sakura Chiyono O doesn't manage to
win a single
round due to how starkly
she wears her emotions
on her sleeve...
